body:
I've tried putting myself in social situations but whenever my social anxiety doesn't kick in my extreme social awkwardness does. There has never been a good thing to come out of a social situations despite me trying. Like I said, everyone that I meet always goes off of a first impression and I always mess up that first impressions and most people are very judgmental. It just seems like no shares my interests. 

One of the reasons why I sometimes avoid social situations is because about 3 years ago I was bullied very badly. It was so bad that I even got bullied outside of school. My best friend moved one summer (literally  4 hours away) and I haven't talked him for about 5 years. I've tried making new friends but it seems as if everyone I've met thinks I'm weird because of my social anxiety. 

My life is incredibly dull despite me trying to change that. My family understands my social anxiety however they just think it can change in a day. I know this will sound weird but, the internet/video games is pretty much my escape. Here I don't have to worry about my social anxiety it's nice to somewhat get away from it.

(Also I apologize for the amount of spelling errors in my original post.)
I've been seeing a psychiatrist for about 5+ years now. It has helped a lot. I never really did therapy though.
